blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Grid Corp. of the Philippines (NGCP) on Saturday placed the Visayas power grid under a yellow alert for one hour due to insufficient operating reserves amid multiple power plant outages and reduced generation capacity. In an advisory issued on Nov. 28, the NGCP said the yellow alert would be in effect from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m. The grid operator reported an available capacity of 2,617 megawatts (MW) against a projected peak demand of 2,369 MW during the period.
